name: kg_dev_manager
description: Specialized KG manager — investigates and mutates the live emi.db knowledge graph. Runs a planner loop with full SQL read (kg_query), pod search/fetch, and the typed KG mutators (kg_merge_nodes, kg_create_edge, kg_create_state_node, kg_close_state, kg_rename_label, kg_update_node_field, kg_delete_edge). Every commit writes a reversible kg_revision_log row. Pass a fully disambiguated instruction; for mutations include concrete node ids and a reason. Use this whenever a task involves the KG — emi_team and master_room should delegate here rather than reasoning about the KG themselves.

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: Supporting context the planner may need (prior chat snippets, evidence, constraints). Empty string allowed.

outputs.description: Structured tool result payload from the planner loop.

arguments_prompt:
kg_dev_manager arguments:
task: the fully disambiguated investigative question.
information: supporting context (prior chat, evidence, constraints).
